dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You are a night owl, too?

dialogues.speaker: Mawyo
dialogues.text: Of course I am! Nighttime is precious, and it'd be a waste if we didn't use it properly.

dialogues.speaker: Mawyo
dialogues.text: Look at this coffee shop. It's a very popular one, and has provided me with a great deal of precious intel.

dialogues.speaker: Mawyo
dialogues.text: Adventurers' commissions, clues to treasure maps, and business opportunities for new toys... Every piece of information contributes to my career as a freelancer.

dialogues.speaker: Mawyo
dialogues.text: Well, although the tavern might be a better source of information, I just can't hold my liquor. So I have to give up on it.
